hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qE '^NAMESPACE$|/NAMESPACE$|^renv\.lock$|/renv\.lock$|^man/[^/]+\.Rd$|/man/[^/]+\.Rd$|^data/[^/]+\.rda$|/data/[^/]+\.rda$'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Generated file (see CLAUDE.md) - regenerate via devtools::document(), data-raw scripts, or renv::snapshot() instead of hand-editing."}}'; fi; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qE '^R/[^/]+\.R$|/R/[^/]+\.R$'; then Rscript -e 'devtools::document()' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; }
